title: Add support to the wiretap SocketCAN API to add an interface
description:
Refactor candump.c so that all CAN wiretaps can take advantage of adding an interface ID their packets.
This creates a "parent" private structure for SocketCAN based wiretaps that includes tracking the interfaces

notes.body:
Which of the formats other than candump have packets from more than one interface and provide a per-packet indication the interface on which the packet was received or sent? Those are the only ones that need that code.

(In the longer term, that mechanism should probably be lifted up to wiretap/wtap.c and generalized so that it can support iptrace, candump, and everything else that can use it.)

PEAK TRC has the concept of "bus ID", which certainly behaves like an interface

Busmaster can provide a new "header" with interface information (using the word "channel") - Current functionality is ignoring the channel and I have been considering converting that wiretap to look more like cllog (and ditch the lemon parsing)

Looks like CLX000 CAN loggers doesn't support multiple headers like Busmaster, but still thought it was a good idea to add interface name, even if there is only 1.
